		continue
	    fi
	else
	    key=""
	fi
	params=""
	makeswap=""
	mke2fs=""
	skip=""
	# Parse the src field for UUID= and convert to real device names
	if [ "${src%%=*}" == "UUID" ]; then
		src=$(/sbin/blkid -t "$src" -l -o device)
	elif [ "${src/^\/dev\/disk\/by-uuid\/}" != "$src" ]; then
		src=$(__readlink $src)
	fi
	[ -z "$src" ] && continue
	[ -b "$src" ] || continue
	# Parse the options field, convert to cryptsetup parameters
	# and contruct the command line
	while [ -n "$opt" ]; do
	    arg=${opt%%,*}
	    opt=${opt##$arg}
	    opt=${opt##,}
	    param=${arg%%=*}
	    value=${arg##$param=}

	    case "$param" in
	    cipher)
		params="$params -c $value"
		if [ -z "$value" ]; then
		    echo $"$dst: no value for cipher option, skipping"
		    skip="yes"
		fi
	    ;;
	    size)
		params="$params -s $value"
		if [ -z "$value" ]; then
		    echo $"$dst: no value for size option, skipping"
		    skip="yes"
		fi
	    ;;
	    hash)
		params="$params -h $value"
		if [ -z "$value" ]; then
		    echo $"$dst: no value for hash option, skipping"
		    skip="yes"
		fi
	    ;;
	    verify)
	        params="$params -y"
	    ;;
	    swap)
		makeswap=yes
		;;
	    tmp)
		mke2fs=yes
	    esac
	done
	if [ "$skip" = "yes" ]; then
	    ret=1
	    continue
	fi
	if [ -z "$key" -a -x /usr/bin/rhgb-client ] \
	    && /usr/bin/rhgb-client --ping ; then
	    chvt 1
	fi
	if cryptsetup isLuks "$src" 2>/dev/null; then
	    if key_is_random "$key"; then
		echo $"$dst: LUKS requires non-random key, skipping"
		ret=1
		continue
	    fi
	    if [ -n "$params" ]; then
		echo "$dst: options are invalid for LUKS partitions," \
		    "ignoring them"
	    fi
	    /sbin/cryptsetup ${key:+-d $key} luksOpen "$src" "$dst" <&1
	else
	    /sbin/cryptsetup $params ${key:+-d $key} create "$dst" "$src" <&1
	fi
	rc=$?
	if [ -z "$key" -a -x /usr/bin/rhgb-client ] \
	    && /usr/bin/rhgb-client --ping ; then
	    chvt 8
	fi
	if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then
	    ret=1
	    continue
	fi
	if [ -b "/dev/mapper/$dst" ]; then
	    if [ "$makeswap" = "yes" ]; then
		mkswap "/dev/mapper/$dst" 2>/dev/null >/dev/null
	    fi
	    if [ "$mke2fs" = "yes" ]; then
		if mke2fs "/dev/mapper/$dst" 2>/dev/null >/dev/null \
		    && mdir=$(mktemp -d /tmp/mountXXXXXX); then
		    mount "/dev/mapper/$dst" "$mdir" && chmod 1777 "$mdir"
		    umount "$mdir"
		    rmdir "$mdir"
		fi
	    fi
	fi
    done < /etc/crypttab
    return $ret
}

#!/bin/sh
# chkconfig: 2345 99 01
# description: Attach, unlock, and mount the secure LUKS volume

BACKING=/var/lib/secure-volume.img
LOOP=/dev/loop7
MAPPER=secure_volume
KEY=/root/.secure-volume.key
MOUNTPOINT=/srv/secure

start_volume() {
    [ -f "$BACKING" ] || { echo "Missing $BACKING"; return 1; }
    [ -r "$KEY" ] || { echo "Missing $KEY"; return 1; }
    mkdir -p "$MOUNTPOINT"

    if /sbin/losetup "$LOOP" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        /sbin/losetup "$LOOP" | /bin/grep -F "($BACKING)" >/dev/null 2>&1 || {
            echo "$LOOP is already in use by another backing file"
            return 1
        }
    else
        /sbin/losetup "$LOOP" "$BACKING" || return 1
    fi

    if [ ! -b "/dev/mapper/$MAPPER" ]; then
        /sbin/cryptsetup -d "$KEY" luksOpen "$LOOP" "$MAPPER" || {
            /sbin/losetup -d "$LOOP" >/dev/null 2>&1
            return 1
        }
    fi

    if ! /bin/grep -qs " $MOUNTPOINT " /proc/mounts; then
        /bin/mount -t ext3 "/dev/mapper/$MAPPER" "$MOUNTPOINT" || return 1
    fi

    chmod 0700 "$MOUNTPOINT"
    touch /var/lock/subsys/secure-volume
    echo "Secure volume mounted on $MOUNTPOINT"
}

stop_volume() {
    if /bin/grep -qs " $MOUNTPOINT " /proc/mounts; then
        /bin/umount "$MOUNTPOINT" || return 1
    fi
    if [ -b "/dev/mapper/$MAPPER" ]; then
        /sbin/cryptsetup luksClose "$MAPPER" || return 1
    fi
    if /sbin/losetup "$LOOP" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        /sbin/losetup -d "$LOOP" || return 1
    fi
    rm -f /var/lock/subsys/secure-volume
    echo "Secure volume stopped"
}

status_volume() {
    /sbin/cryptsetup status "$MAPPER" || return 1
    /bin/grep " $MOUNTPOINT " /proc/mounts
}

case "$1" in
    start) start_volume ;;
    stop) stop_volume ;;
    restart) stop_volume && start_volume ;;
    status) status_volume ;;
    *) echo "Usage: $0 {start|stop|restart|status}"; exit 2 ;;
esac
ANTRIEB_SECURE_VOLUME
